ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a day off for {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A kind colonist, or someone close to a colonist who has been worn down for two days, asks the council to give them a day off. Met when they are given the heart's day off, or rest on one of the calendar's rest days while it waits.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {OTHER_nameDef} is given a day off (beside the strain meter on {OTHER_possessive} Mood tab, on {OTHER_possessive} card or in the heart's advice), or rests on one of the calendar's rest days.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} hasn't laughed in a week, and still gets up before anyone. Give {OTHER_objective} a day. I'll do {OTHER_possessive} share.
I watched {OTHER_nameDef} stand at the bench holding a tool and not remembering what it was for. One day off, before it gets worse.
{OTHER_nameDef} answers every question with "fine" now, even the ones that aren't questions. Let {OTHER_objective} have a day to be something other than fine.
Nobody is going to ask for {OTHER_nameDef}, least of all {OTHER_nameDef}. So I am asking. One day of rest, and the work will keep.
[trait:Kind] I can carry a little more for a day. {OTHER_nameDef} can't carry any more at all. Let me take some of it.
[winter] The days are short and {OTHER_nameDef} works every hour of them, and some of the dark ones too. Let {OTHER_objective} sit by the fire for a day.
[lowtech] Where I come from, you rest the ox before it falls in the furrow. {OTHER_nameDef} is no ox, but the same sense holds.
[!lowtech] Even the machines here get switched off now and then. {OTHER_nameDef} hasn't been, not for days.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would never ask, so I will. One day, that's all, and I'll see the work gets done.
I don't want much. Just a day where {OTHER_nameDef} wakes up and has nowhere to be.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is running on nothing. Give {OTHER_objective} a day off before the choice is made for us.

cheerful.li: I have a plan for {OTHER_nameDef}: a lie-in, a long walk, and no work at all. All it needs is the council's say-so.

gloomy.li: I've seen people go the way {OTHER_nameDef} is going. A day off now costs less than what comes after.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s work has slipped two days running. A day of rest will get more out of {OTHER_objective} than another day like these.

plain.li: Thank you for giving {OTHER_nameDef} the day. {OTHER_nameDef} won't say it, so I'm saying it for both of us.
A whole day of rest for {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll make sure nobody comes looking for {OTHER_objective} with work.
[promised] The council said it would see to it, and it did. {OTHER_nameDef} needed this more than anyone knew.

warm.li: Thank you, truly. I'll keep an eye out that {OTHER_nameDef} actually rests and doesn't sneak back to work.

cheerful.li: A whole day of nothing for {OTHER_nameDef}. I could hug the council, all of it, one by one.

gloomy.li: One day won't mend everything, but it's a day. Thank you.

cold.li: Noted, and appreciated. {OTHER_nameDef} will be the better for it.

plain.li: No day off for {OTHER_nameDef}, then. I won't tell {OTHER_objective} anyone asked.
[promised] The council said it would see to it. {OTHER_nameDef} is still at it from dawn, and I'm the only one who knows anyone asked.

warm.li: I'll take some of {OTHER_nameDef}'s work myself, quietly. Someone has to.

gloomy.li: Of course. Nobody rests here until they fall over.

cold.li: So the council thinks {OTHER_nameDef} can go on as before. We'll see.
